concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-pix-ios-component]] — 2026-09-15-captured Pix iOS Components Sessions/Advanced add-on for request data, InstantPaymentComponent, QR action and asynchronous test/live handling.
warnings: Advanced Components prerequisite points to a Drop-in base-guide URL; the /payments table uses onSubmit state wording that the iOS example does not reconcile.

The QR/Pending response and test offer promotion do not establish final live payment success or merchant eligibility.
